raw_payload.what_happens: Lakhā kneels, tears welling up as he unties the letter from the dog's collar. He reads the Sheth's confession—an explanation of the theft and a promise to repay. The truth crashes over him like a wave; his legs give way and he collapses onto the marble floor, stunned and humbled.
raw_payload.narration: Lakhā kneels, tears swelling as he unties the letter from the dog's neck, reading the Sheth's confession of theft and promise of repayment. The truth crashes over him; his legs give way, collapsing onto marble, humbled.
